title: Wizard mode choice cards: 'AI Assisted' and 'Manual assessment' — cosmetic implementation blocked until backlog-260 and 261 deliver the AI-loop contracts
goal: Add a mode selection step at the top of the wizard that shows two cards: (A) 'AI Assisted' — AI drives the assessment, operator approves at tier boundaries. (B) 'Manual assessment' — current tile/depth/phase workflow unchanged. IMPORTANT: This task implements the UI cards and routing only. The 'AI Assisted' card MUST check that backlog-260 (AI loop engine) is running and backlog-261 (wizard mode contract) has been deployed. If ai_loop capability is not available: the 'AI Assisted' card shows a 'Coming soon' disabled state rather than a non-functional button. This prevents cosmetic UI without working backend. Card A ('AI Assisted'): visually prominent, project icon (not emoji) for 'automated', Recommended badge. Fields: Target (URL/IP/CIDR/domain), Maximum authorization tier (four options with plain-language descriptions: 'Discovery only — no active probing' / 'Active scanning — no credential attacks' / 'Full assessment including credential testing' / 'Full pentest including controlled exploitation'). Optional: credentials reference. CTA: 'Start AI Assessment'. On click: creates run with run_mode=ai_loop, redirects to Mission Control. Card B ('Manual assessment'): secondary styling, project icon for 'sliders/manual'. Label: 'Advanced'. CTA: 'Choose assessment type'. On click: opens current tile selection step unchanged. FRAMING: Not 'AI vs human' but 'AI Assisted' vs 'Manual'. Copy: 'AI Assisted: The assessment adapts to what it finds. AI proposes each next step for your approval.' Manual: 'Full control over every phase and tool selection.' Icon system: use existing Lucide icons or project icon set — no emoji anywhere in the component.
scope: ChatGPT review 2026-05-06: wizard UI cards are right but must not become functional before 260/261 deliver the backend contracts. Cosmetic UI without working motor is worse than nothing. Use project icon system not emoji. Framing: AI Assisted vs Manual, not AI vs Human.
generation_reason: Wizard mode choice UI. Functional only after backlog-260/261 complete. Shows disabled state otherwise. No emoji — project icon system.

inputs.prerequisite_backlog: backlog-260 and backlog-261 MUST be completed before this task is promoted. The 'AI Assisted' card must check for ai_loop capability at runtime — if absent, show disabled/coming-soon state.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Add mode choice before existing tile grid only. Never remove or change the manual tile/depth flow. If ai_loop not available: show disabled card, not broken functionality.
constraints.icon_system: Use existing project Lucide icons. No emoji anywhere in the component.

success_criteria: Wizard shows two mode cards before tile grid.
'AI Assisted' card checks ai_loop capability at runtime — shows disabled if backlog-260 not deployed.
'Manual assessment' card always enabled and opens existing tile flow.
Card A creates run with run_mode=ai_loop when functional.
Card B opens existing tile grid unchanged.
No emoji anywhere in the component — existing icon system only.
Authorization tier options have plain-language descriptions.
Framing is 'AI Assisted' vs 'Manual', not 'AI' vs 'Human'.
No regression in existing manual wizard E2E tests.

acceptance_criteria: Two mode cards visible on wizard load.
AI Assisted card disabled when ai_loop not available.
Manual mode opens tile grid unchanged.
